outcome: Trainee performance (pre- and postmodule quizzes, oral and written exams, case logs, Entrustable Professional Activities - EPAs)
cohort: Two local medical doctors were enrolled in the second VitalSurg cohort in South Sudan.
finding: The VitalSurg program demonstrated the feasibility of embedding task-shifting surgical training into humanitarian clinical activities, showing trainees improved across all evaluation domains over 18 months.
mod_finding: The EPA pass rate for Caesarean section procedures was 43.5% among trainees.
